Agreed next steps, in order: employee master + end-of-service (occupied HC computed; resignation offers a ready replacement request; periodic reconciliation with payroll), job descriptions inside the system with the new-position process including the JD, English UI with per-user language control (user choice / forced Arabic / forced English), then Phase 3B

Job description content completed for all non-executive jobs: 110 further JDs written as draft 0.1 (finance 18, HR 13, IT and admin/security 13, legal/audit/OSH 7, commercial and marketing 19, operations leadership and factory support 27, supply chain 13), on top of the 108 pilot JDs — 218 in total. English interface (v0.7.0): every screen can show in English, left-to-right, through a translation dictionary of 1,885 texts; master data shows its English name (\_EN columns) when filled, otherwise Arabic. Sources, subscriptions and job ads (v0.8.0, Phase 3B-1): RECRUITMENT\_SOURCES table replaces the CANDIDATE\_SOURCES setting (13 sources, migrated automatically). Screens are in Arabic and English

Two phases added to the roadmap (scope to be detailed before each starts): Operational reports (after phase 5 — requests, vacancies, candidates, ads, offers, joiners; filters and export) and an Interactive process map (after phase 7 — clickable end-to-end map of the recruitment and new-hire process, each step showing owner, rules, SLA and the portal screen). Phase 8 Intelligence stays last

Decisions from the phase 1–3 audit: (1) approval reminders, escalation and daily digest run on a daily scheduled trigger; a request step left unapproved 30 days counts as rejected. (2) HC exceptions are approved by the HR Sector Manager only, as a separate approval. (3) HR notes on a request are visible to the HR team only (separate internal field). (5) Rejection reasons and activity types become editable lists. (6) Manual merge of duplicate persons is kept. (7) Data retention/deletion per the privacy text to be built; privacy text still awaits legal review. (4) Cancelling a vacancy requires a decision per open application: transfer / talent pool / reject due to cancellation / hold (built with 3B-3). (8) AI CV reading and summary help move to phase 8. (9) Agreed in principle: application owner with 3B-2; former-employee check, do-not-rehire and per-vacancy screening questions with 3B-3; candidate secure link with phase 5. (10) Admin screens for delegation, job/grade edit and reasons are built before 3B-2

CHG-40 items (1), (2), (3), (5) and (10) built in v0.8.1. Daily job on a time-driven trigger at DIGEST\_TIME (first portal call of the day runs it when the trigger is missing or missed a day, without the digest): in-app reminder every APPROVAL\_REMIND\_DAYS (3), one escalation to the HR Sector Manager and HR Manager after APPROVAL\_ESCALATE\_DAYS (7), warning APPROVAL\_EXPIRY\_WARN\_DAYS (5) before expiry, and a step without a decision for APPROVAL\_EXPIRE\_DAYS (30) is rejected by the system (recruitment requests and new-position requests); one digest email per user with approvals waiting or a request returned. EMAIL\_DAILY\_BUDGET now enforced (login codes always go). HC exception = separate step HC\_EXC after HR review, HR Sector Manager only: approve, approve within available HC (lines cut to what is free, requester told), return or reject; skipped when HR approves within available; the HR Sector Manager reviewing as HR may record both approvals in one go (two records); his own request approves both on submission; the old HR Manager / CEO exception rules stopped. HR\_Internal\_Notes on the request: HR and recruitment roles only, never in the timeline, notifications or print; audited. Admin screens: delegation (unit-head approval authority to a user for up to one year; stop only), editable lists (request reject/return, candidate reject/withdraw, end-of-service reasons, candidate activity types; built-in items renamed only), job data and grade edit on the job page with change history (grade by the HR Sector Manager only). Item (7) data retention waits for the legal review of the privacy text.

Phase 3B-2 built (v0.9.0). Application owner (Owner\_User\_ID): one recruiter per application from the vacancy team, default the creator or the lead; hand-over by the owner, the lead or a recruitment manager; applications of a recruiter removed from the team go back to the lead; My tasks follow the owner. Employee referrals (REFERRALS): referrer picked from active employees in the employee master, first referral per vacancy wins, no self-referral, PRIMARY on a referral source and INFLUENCING otherwise; bonus status PENDING (due after hire + probation) / REVIEW (HR decides: influencing, internal or candidate already applied within REFERRAL\_PRIOR\_DAYS = 180) / ELIGIBLE / NOT\_ELIGIBLE / PAID, decided by HR admins in the referrals register; the portal pays nothing. A referrer typed on the public form waits for recruiter confirmation. Agencies (AGENCIES): fee basis and value, guarantee days, replacement terms, ownership days, contract link; terms snapshot on each submission; another agency cannot submit a candidate during ownership, other sources get a warning. Original\_Source kept; source change needs a reason and is logged; source, agency and referral lock when the application is rejected or withdrawn (hire lock follows with phase 5). Existing applications migrated (owner = lead, original source, locks, typed referrers as REVIEW).

Phase 3B-3 built (v0.10.0). Screening questions (SCREEN\_QUESTIONS): editable library seeded with 6 questions; each vacancy picks its questions and optional knockout answers; applicants answer on the public form; a knockout answer flags the application for review (never auto-rejects) and the recruitment team accepts or rejects it from the candidate page or My tasks. Talent pool (TALENT\_POOL): candidates saved by category, suggested when a matching vacancy opens, moved to a vacancy in one step. Transfer to another vacancy creates a linked new application (Origin\_Application\_ID) and closes the old one as withdrawn - transferred. Cancelling a vacancy with active candidates requires a decision per candidate (transfer / pool / reject / hold). Bulk import (IMPORT\_BATCHES): paste from Excel, max 300 rows, preview flags new / possible duplicate / already on vacancy / missing mobile / invalid / duplicate in file, per-row link / new / skip, batch number IMB-YYYY-NNNN. Source performance tab: applicants and reach to interview, offer and hire per source. Former employees: name/mobile match against exited employees shows a warning that HR confirms or dismisses; no-rehire restrictions (HIRING\_RESTRICTIONS) recorded with a reason by HR admins only; any application by a restricted person alerts the managers, who decide.

Phase 4 split: 4A interviews (built, v0.11.0); 4B practical / technical assessments, 2-hour reminders and reconfirmation, interviewer analytics and per-job round templates. 4A: interview rounds per vacancy (Plan\_JSON, default INTERVIEW\_DEFAULT\_PLAN = HR required, direct manager technical required, senior final optional; type HR / MANAGER / SENIOR / OTHER drives the competencies and questions shown). New stage INTERVIEW, entered only by scheduling the first interview; the hiring manager sees SHORTLISTED and INTERVIEW candidates. INTERVIEWS + INTERVIEW\_PANEL (one lead; technical, HR, observer, decision participant): Proposed → Manager Confirmed → Candidate Pending → Confirmed → Checked-in → Started → Completed → Evaluated; the invitation is blocked until the lead confirms (INT-001); exceptions manager / candidate declined, rescheduled (linked), no-show, manager no-show, cancelled, controlled ad-hoc with reason, round waived by recruitment managers / HR with reason; closing or transferring a candidate cancels live interviews. Check-in, screen opened, first note, start, end and each evaluation are recorded as events; evidence reported as facts (waiting minutes, late arrival, duration). Interviewer workspace: candidate summary (no salary / contact outside the recruitment team), CV through the interview, approved JD, round competencies with anchors and library questions, HR standard question bank (INTERVIEW\_QUESTIONS, 10 seeded, mandatory or suggested), requirements from the request (education, experience, essential skills). EVALUATIONS: requirements Met / Not met / Needs verification with evidence (all required in HR and manager rounds), competencies 1–5 against the required level (evidence for 1 and 5), mandatory questions must be asked, interviewer-added questions, recommendation Strongly proceed / Proceed / Hold / Do not proceed; independent (hidden while the user still owes an evaluation on that candidate); revision = new version with reason, old superseded; late after EVAL\_SLA\_HOURS (24) measured. Live comparison and readiness (not ready / ready for decision / deferred): incomplete as x/y, conflicting recommendations flagged never averaged, competency averages with rater count and spread, requirements by worst status; salary only for the recruitment team. Daily job: unconfirmed after INTERVIEW\_CONFIRM\_HOURS, tomorrow reminders, unrecorded past interviews, late evaluations with escalation to recruitment managers at 2× SLA. Selection decisions (selected / reserve) stay with phase 5.

v0.11.1 — fixes accepted from an external code review (Gemini, all 29 files in five parts; about a third of its points held, no authorization gap found). Text starting with "=" is stored with a look-alike sign so it can never become a sheet formula (public apply page, import, every write). Login-code attempts counted and checked under the lock. Audit trail, timeline events and notifications are appended without reading the whole table; the ID counter is not re-read inside the same lock. Unit move checked under the lock and tree walks guarded against loops. CVs uploaded to Drive before taking the lock. Online applications capped per vacancy per hour (APPLY\_MAX\_PER\_VACANCY\_HOUR = 60; lead recruiter told). Former-employee name match uses four words when both names have them. Weekly days off WEEKEND\_DAYS = Friday and Saturday: no reminders, escalations or digest on those days, and they do not count in approval waiting days or evaluation lateness. Every data sheet warns before a hand edit. New automatic XSS test: HTML/script typed into names, notes, questions, round names and summaries shows as text on every screen and never runs. Deferred: data archiving (with the retention decision CHG-40/7), splitting Index.html (with the move to a real database).

v0.12.0 (Phase 4B): practical / written / skills assessment rounds with criteria from the JD and competency tests; HSE safety checklist before shop-floor tests; result form (pass/fail per item, optional score out of 100, evidence files, PASS / FAIL / RETEST) — a fail flags the candidate and never auto-rejects; round templates per job / job family, vacancy plan frozen at its first interview; day-before reconfirmation; hourly job for 2-hour panel reminders + candidate reminder email; interviewer analytics for calibration only.

v0.12.1: fix for 'system busy' at login after an upgrade — the in-request upgrade no longer re-formats or re-protects existing sheets (protection runs once from the daily job); other users see 'portal is updating, try again in a minute' instead of queueing on the lock; a stuck upgrade is retried after 6 minutes.

v0.13.0 (Phase 5A): selection decision (selected / reserve / hold / more interview / rejected) with readiness snapshot and exception justification; hiring manager may decide (not reject); optional reference checks with consent; versioned salary structures per grade, pay components (fixed / variable, show-on-letter) and OFFER\_AUTHORITY matrix edited by the HR Sector Manager; offers with calculated fixed package, lowest-sufficient-authority routing with fallback, self-approval within own limit, return, negotiation versions, salary trail, offer letter (print / email), acceptance with signed copy, decline reasons with reserve reminder, validity + daily expiry + HR extension, over-hiring check with HR override; salaries hidden from hiring managers; new stages OFFER and ACCEPTED. Joining and documents follow in 5B.

v0.13.1: offers follow Kandil's package rules (owner decision 2026-10-05) — the offer starts from the agreed amount (Gross or Net); allowances come from a versioned per-grade table (collar W/B/G, transport: Inshas = first column, elsewhere = first + extra; meal, phone, representation, cost of living, job-nature eligibility) and per unit/department job-nature rates (2026), with per-job overrides, location transport zones and temporary transport by decision; basic = amount − allowances; contribution wage = full × 60% capped 16,700, rounded to 500, floor 5,500 (social insurance 11%); comprehensive wage = contribution wage topped up to 7,000 (tax base after insurance and the 20,000 exemption, progressive brackets); martyrs fund borne by the company; Net contracts grossed up with the difference as «Net allowance»; incentive as a separate annex decided only by the HR Sector Manager. All figures editable yearly from the Salaries & offers screen.

v0.14.0 (Phase 5B): joining and hiring documents (owner decisions 2026-10-05) — an accepted offer opens a joining record (planned date with change history, date confirmation notifies the manager); 12 document types seeded (original kept / copy / paper, copies, scope all / males / collar / listed jobs, digital copy, expiry, deferrable with max days, insured-only); the candidate uploads from a private link or HR uploads, the recruiter reviews, paper receipt ticked separately, versions kept per person on Drive; deferral and waiver by the Recruitment Manager; joined → vacancy fill + employee record, did not join → withdrawn with reason; the receipt of hiring documents prints only when every required document is complete; payroll cut-off day 25 with a 7-day alert — the portal lists and records stop / release notices, it never stops a salary itself; contracts without social insurance need the CEO or the Chairman / Vice Chairman, insurance is zero and the work stub, insurance print, form 111, practice permit and skill certificate become optional (recorded if brought).

Owner decisions: probation is at most 90 days with the same employer, never repeated on rehire; STEPS HR & Payroll not approved, so phases 6 and 7 (employee file, onboarding, social insurance, probation, medical insurance) are built in this portal, and a full HR system follows later as a separate project.

Owner decisions: the 4 legal entities count as one employer, so probation is never repeated on rehire or on a move between entities. Probation: at most 3 months; once per employer; the contract must state the probation and its length (offer / contract carries the probation days); either party may end the contract during probation, usually without compensation or end-of-service pay. Social insurance: legally due from the first working day; the company may start it from the 1st of the following month or from the date the hiring documents are complete (especially form 111) — the portal will hold the start rule as a setting and track it per employee. Privacy notice to be drafted externally and reviewed before legal sign-off.

v0.14.1: personal-data protection (privacy notice drafted externally, reviewed; final wording awaits legal). Separate recorded consents with the notice version (application, storage on Google possibly outside Egypt, salary data as sensitive financial data, optional talent pool for RETENTION\_POOL\_MONTHS = 12); talent pool only with consent; explicit hiring-documents consent (link or signed paper) before the first upload; criminal record and form 111 open for the application owner and HR / recruitment managers only; legal entities linked to the structure and shown as employer (more can be added later); data-subject requests (access export, correction, deletion, pool withdrawal) with a due date; retention list (rejected 6 months, did not join 3 months — periods editable, owner to decide) with manual deletion, automatic deletion off until the HR Sector Manager switches it on; DPO = wages supervisor, privacy email to be set. Hiring-document files are kept (owner decision). WhatsApp contact from company numbers. Open: move from a personal Google account to Workspace or Supabase before real candidate data.

v0.15.0: sign-in with an authenticator app (TOTP) as an alternative to email codes; once on, email codes stop for that account (also saves the Gmail daily quota). Required from the first sign-in for system owner, HR sector manager, HR manager / staff, recruitment team and consultant (TOTP\_REQUIRED\_ROLES); everyone else after 3 email sign-ins (TOTP\_AFTER\_EMAIL\_LOGINS). QR drawn on the device, 8 one-time recovery codes, secret stored encrypted, codes not reusable, 15-minute pause after 5 wrong codes. Reset by system owner / HR sector manager with a reason (closes sessions); emergency owner reset from the script editor via a script property. New role Consultant (view only): sees every screen including pay (owner decision), server refuses all writes, alone, end date (max 180 days), no position, granted by owner / HR sector manager, confidentiality acknowledgement at first sign-in (interim text, final after legal). Notes button on every screen + Notes screen (status and reply, author notified). Decision: the 'twice a day' rule replaced by role-based enforcement.

v0.15.1: short 'for whom / where to start' intro under 24 screen titles, closed and reopened per user (saved per account). Owner and HR sector manager can switch on coloured dots showing who sees each menu item (everyone / managers and approvers / HR and recruitment team / HR sector manager and system owner only) with a legend; one meaning per visual channel so it does not clash with the planned org-chart status colours. Guide answers on the authenticator and notes. Agreed order after this: v0.16 org chart (headcount status colours + sector colours, 8 sectors), recruitment policy inside the portal after the owner approves the draft, then phase 6 onboarding as a full in-portal program.

v0.16.0: Org chart screen. Tree of the active structure; every card shows actual / approved headcount including everything below it. Card fill = headcount status per position (over approved / short / full / empty), always with number and icon; units also show counts of over, short and empty positions below them. Top band = sector colour (fixed palette in sector order, override per sector in SECTOR\_COLORS); departments take their sector's colour. 'On the way' = remaining headcount of open vacancies, with new hires waiting to join. By unit / by position view, sector filter, status filter (dims the rest), search by unit, position or holder name that opens the path, open / close all, zoom and fit, print A4 landscape, unit details with its positions and holders. Visibility: HR, recruitment, CEO, board, consultant, viewer = whole company; a line manager = his units only; others refused. Phone = indented list.

v0.17.0 (phase 6A): full onboarding program inside the portal + employee e-file. Owner decisions: full program (not a simple record); three templates are enough (factory / showroom / office, chosen from the location type; factories and warehouses = factory); task owners = HR site specialist, recruiter, supervisor and line manager (plus the buddy); social insurance starts on the first working day by default (setting comes in v0.18). Templates hold phased activities (before day one / day one / first week / first month) with a day offset, owner role and employee-acknowledgement flag; editable and copyable by system owner, HR sector manager and HR manager. A program opens when the joining date is confirmed; tasks are dated from the start (weekly days off moved) and assigned to real users (HR site specialist per location, vacancy lead recruiter, reports-to holder, unit head, buddy or the supervisor until a buddy is set). Date changes re-date open tasks; joined links the employee and re-dates to the real first day; did-not-join cancels. Done / won't do (reason) / reopen; flagged tasks need the employee's acknowledgement; manager or supervisor sets the buddy and adds tasks; HR changes owners (open tasks move); program closes with the employee's acknowledgement (paper / in person / none with a reason), HR may close earlier with a reason; print for signature; daily one-time late reminders; home to-do. Program by hand for current employees. Employee e-file: hiring record, hiring documents and their status, onboarding progress, agreed package for pay roles.

v0.18.0 (phase 6B): welcome gift, social-insurance tracking, New Hire Voice. Gift: recorded on the onboarding program (choice list WELCOME\_GIFTS, delivery date, by whom, employee signature) by HR, manager or supervisor. Insurance: one case per new hire opened on joining; start per INSURANCE\_START\_RULE (owner decision: first working day by default; alternatives next month / documents complete, the latter set when the documents receipt is issued); office per location (INSURANCE\_OFFICES list, 13 offices to be entered); to submit → submitted (date, request ref) → registered (insurance number, unique); no-insurance contracts marked; late after INSURANCE\_SUBMIT\_DAYS = 7 (interim, to confirm with the insurance officer) with one alert to HR managers and the site specialist; HR roles only. New Hire Voice: surveys at day 7 and 30 (NHV\_DAYS) on a private no-login link (Voice.html, Arabic / English, phone first), emailed when the person has an email, otherwise the HR site specialist sends it by WhatsApp and marks it sent; 5 default questions (1–5 + comment, editable in NHV\_QUESTIONS); answers visible to HR team and recruitment manager only, never to the line manager by name; averages per question per round; any score at or below NHV\_ALERT\_SCORE = 2 alerts the site specialist and HR managers and stays in the to-do until a follow-up note is recorded. Employee e-file shows insurance and survey status.
reference_sections: Phase 6; 9.1; open: insurance submit days, offices list

description: v0.19.0 (phase 6C): internal transfers, per the owner's rules. Opened by the employee's current manager or anyone in the HR team (one open request per employee). The target must have room: free approved headcount or an open vacancy; when a vacancy exists the transfer is linked to it and fills / closes it on execution (recorded as internal transfer); room is reserved while the request is open. Approvals: current manager → new manager → HR manager → HR sector manager when salary items change (requester steps auto-approved, empty steps skipped with reason; reject with reason). Allowances tied to the job or the unit (grade, collar, transport zone, job-nature rate) are detected and force a salary-items change (items from → to, or a note); agreed different benefits can be added; amounts visible to HR and pay roles only. Working-hours and location changes recorded (history note). Executed on the effective date (immediately if due, else by the daily job); headcount recounted; managers notified; printable salary-items notice for payroll with a 'sent to payroll' record. Not built (owner did not ask): short onboarding for the new unit.

v0.20.0: demo data + wipe transactions (owner request: test every case with non-real data in the same portal, then empty it). Owner-only screen. Seeding in 7 ordered stages through the real services on the real structure: demo users (HR, recruitment, managers placed on unit heads with no account) and demo employees (short/full/over/empty headcount); requests in every state, vacancies, new-position request; candidates in every stage + a duplicate; interviews (upcoming, done, late evaluation, no-show), evaluations, selections; offers (accepted, presented, declined, pending, draft); joining with missing/deferred/rejected documents, onboarding, gift, insurance, surveys (good and low), did-not-join; transfers in every state, personal-data requests, an exit. Demo people use @demo.invalid; no email at all is sent while seeding. 'Try as' lets the owner open the portal as a demo user (yellow banner, back to own account, audited). Wipe: typed phrase + reason + authenticator code; copies the 7 spreadsheets to a Backup folder first; clears every transaction table (real and demo), removes demo users/employees, restarts counters, recounts or restores headcount, trashes uploaded files; keeps structure, jobs, JDs, locations, real users/roles/MFA, real employees and history, settings, lists, pay tables, templates, notes, audit log.

Probation is one period only, at most 90 days (PROBATION\_DAYS), with no extension. The direct manager sets 3–5 measurable goals in the first week and the employee acknowledges them; follow-up reviews on day 30 and day 60; self-assessment, then the final evaluation on day 75 on the annual appraisal items (productivity 35%, quality 25%, four core values 10% each, 1–5 with evidence; confirming needs a weighted score of 3 or more and no value below 2). An improvement plan (PIP) must start by day 60 so it ends inside the period. The manager recommends; HR decides by day 80: confirming = HR team, ending employment = HR Sector Manager only, with written reasons; the decision is told in a meeting, then a printed letter. Built v0.25.0.

Stay interview near day 60: HR with the employee, without the manager (what he likes, what could make him leave, manager support, intent to stay, risk level); a high risk alerts the HR managers and the HR site specialist; HR only. Manager satisfaction survey: 3 questions to the direct manager after confirmation, feeding the quality-of-hire KPI. Built v0.26.0.

Medical insurance case opened automatically on confirmation; the employee is added within MEDICAL\_ADD\_DAYS (14) with insurer and card number, or marked not added with a reason; late cases alert HR; HR team only. Built v0.25.0.

Recruitment KPIs computed from the portal's own records: process KPIs in 5 groups (speed, quality, efficiency & cost, candidate experience, compliance); weighted scorecards (weights sum to 100, score 1–5 on the appraisal scale) per recruiter, recruitment lead and HR site specialist; service KPIs of managers, approvers and interview panels for information only (not in any score); drill-down to cases, Excel export, monthly e-mail to the recruitment manager, HR manager and HR Sector Manager. Built v0.26.0.

KPI targets, target days-to-fill per job class, job class per grade and scorecard weights are edited on the KPI screen (no JSON typing) by the system owner, HR Sector Manager and HR Manager only, each change with a reason and audited; the rest of HR / recruitment and the consultant view only. Built v0.27.0.

Every user sees his own evaluation ("My evaluation"): the scorecards that apply to him and his service as manager, approver and evaluator, with only his own cases behind them. The probation employee sees the day-30 and day-60 follow-ups on his link once the manager saves them, and the final evaluation only after the HR decision; internal notes, the stay interview and the manager survey are never shown to him. Built v0.27.0.

Every form is printable from inside the program: a print button in every form window and beside each page title prints the form with its data, blank lines for empty fields, logo, date and a signature table. A forms book holds every portal form on demo data, in workflow order. Built v0.24.0–v0.26.0.

Post-approval request changes: only a headcount increase goes back to approval (as a linked request that tops up the same vacancy); every other change (date, specs, priority, employment type, branch, decrease) is recorded by HR with a reason as an amendment version. Bulk vacancy assignment and moving a recruiter's whole workload. Approved JD e-mailed with PDF to portal users only (not candidates). Application salary stays optional for everyone, not labelled optional, zero refused.

Phase 8 first part built: source return (funnel to confirmation, quality, time to hire, cost per hire incl. ads, subscriptions spread over the period, agency fees, referral bonus estimate), bottlenecks (each process step with average / median / 90th percentile, waiting, overdue, slowest people, oldest cases) and interviewer calibration (deviation from the rest of the panel, recommendation vs outcome, interview score vs final probation score). Forecasting waits for \~6 months of data; AI CV help waits for an owner decision on the AI service.
Go-live readiness screen (automatic checks + manual items ticked and audited) and the hiring forecast (next quarter by job class and sector, expected time to fill, confidence by months of history).

AI CV reading (Claude, Anthropic API): on the candidate page the recruiter asks the system to read the CV (PDF, image or .docx) against the vacancy's approved JD; it returns suggestions only — fields the recruiter ticks to save (audited), a short summary, skills, and a 1–5 match on job-related criteria (age, gender, religion, marital status, nationality, photo excluded). Never moves or rejects a candidate. One reading per CV per vacancy (saved), monthly cost cap CVAI\_MONTH\_CAP\_USD (default US$10, \~1 cent per CV on Claude Haiku 4.5), API key kept in the script properties, readings blanked when a candidate's data is deleted. Owner decision; cross-border transfer of CV data to go to the lawyer review.

Profile photos (built v0.33): a small thumbnail for candidates and portal users. A candidate photo needs a separate optional consent on the apply page and a line in the privacy notice; hiring managers do not see it until after the interview; it is deleted with the candidate's data.

AI CV reading may run on test data now; the go-live step reminds about the cross-border transfer licence. What is sent excludes the photo and National ID; the address is reduced to "district, governorate". The job-related match is shown as a percentage (advisory only: never sorts, filters, moves or rejects). The portal flags a long commute (candidate governorate / district far from the vacancy location) for information. Amends §1 and §10.1. Built v0.37.0 (§10.1 note).

Separation of duties. No user grants himself a role or changes his own role, position or delegation. CEO and Board roles and the heads of top units are given only with the CEO's approval. The HR Sector Manager is the highest HR authority: he approves HR-sector requests and headcount exceptions (one rule replaces the five in §5, §19, §26.1, CHG-01) and may send any item to the CEO; anything that concerns him personally (his own pay, offer, position, a relative, a request where he is the subject) goes to the CEO. Built v0.36.0.

CEO approval channel: the CEO approves in the portal from a link the HR Sector Manager sends on WhatsApp; approval needs the CEO's trusted device (90 days, renewable; the owner sees the days left) plus a PIN only the CEO knows (stored hashed). One page lists everything waiting for the CEO. Built v0.36.0.

Delegation by process: a delegation lists the processes delegated (anything not listed stays with the delegator); each change is a new version; a delegation of CEO authority takes effect only after the CEO approves it; at most 90 days, renewable. Built v0.36.0.

Two-person rule: data wipe and resetting an administrator's sign-in are requested by one user (the Payroll & Salaries Supervisor) and approved by the HR Sector Manager — never the same person. Ending employment: the unit manager requests, the HR Sector Manager approves. Built v0.36.0.

Oversight: a monthly report to the CEO (decisions taken under delegation, two steps taken by one person, role and delegation changes) and a quarterly access review approved by the HR Sector Manager. A vacant unit head is skipped upwards and HR is alerted. A Board decision recorded on its behalf needs an attachment (minutes, written approval or a WhatsApp screenshot). Built v0.36.0.

Operations: Gmail until go-live, Google Workspace after go-live (a database such as Supabase decided after 6 months of real use); weekly backups kept 8 weeks with a quarterly restore test; e-mail priority login codes → candidates → approvals → daily summary (at most half the budget); the daily summary e-mail goes to managers only; a data protection officer outside HR; breach procedure (owner reports, DPO decides and notifies within 72 h) with an incident log in the portal; Anthropic key rotated every 6 months. Built v0.37.0: weekly backups, restore-test record, DPO and incident log, key-rotation reminder, daily summary e-mail to managers only.

Legal positions (owner, lawyer to confirm): payroll notice for missing documents stays (since CHG-103 a notice to follow up, never a stop of pay); social insurance from the first working day (anything else is an exception with a reason and approval); a contract without social insurance needs the legal basis and a portal form printed, signed and uploaded back; background and criminal-record checks for all jobs with written consent uploaded first; retention 2 years with automatic deletion; under-18 applicants need guardian consent; data-subject requests answered within 30 days with a recorded identity check (objection and withdrawal of AI consent included). Built v0.38.0 (§9.6).

Candidate privacy: candidates added by hand, import or job sites get the privacy notice and a consent link and cannot pass "Contacted" without a recorded consent; salary on the apply form is optional and a range (current salary asked at the offer stage); relatives question with a match alert and a no-relation declaration by interviewers and approvers; optional accommodation question and a 5 % disability indicator; survey results hidden below 5 answers; every user accepts a usage policy once and staff are told that the portal computes their service indicators. Built v0.38.0 (§9.6).

Sign-in: authenticator app mandatory from the first sign-in for every user (the CEO may use the trusted device + PIN of CHG-75); session one working day, remember-me 7 days, idle lock enforced on the server; private links valid 7 days, revoked when their purpose is done, with "send a new link". A go-live button locks demo data and the data wipe for good. The consultant keeps full access and export while the data is test data only; restricted before go-live. Built v0.37.0; the private-link rules built v0.39.0 (§9.7).

Candidate self-service link: the candidate completes his data and CV, confirms or declines an interview and answers the offer from a private link; the recruiter can still do each step on his behalf (recorded as on-behalf). Built v0.39.0 (§9.7).

Workflow: offer letter net pay marked "estimated" and reviewed by the payroll supervisor before sending; recruiter offer authority = grade minimum exactly; WhatsApp offers from each recruiter's own work number; employment-contract stage after acceptance (Arabic form with entity and probation, signed copy uploaded; joining not blocked); HR may change branch or contract type after approval alone (risk accepted, reason logged, requester told); hiring ban reviewed every 2 years with appeal; response deadline 5 working days (owner correction, v0.40.1; first recorded as 10); deferred documents escalated after 7 days; expiries, transfers and probation run every day, reminders and escalations pause Fri–Sat. Built v0.40.0 (§5, §7.1, §9.1, §13.3, §13.6, §14.6, §20). «Response deadline» is the deadline of an approval step: 5 working days without a decision → rejected; reminder on day 2, escalation to the HR Sector Manager and HR Manager on day 3, warning to the approver and requester on day 4 (v0.40.1).

Transfers and onboarding: the receiving manager may start a transfer; managers give an opinion only; temporary transfer type, handover list and a replacement request on execution; onboarding owners for IT, admin and safety, a custody and PPE log and an "arriving tomorrow" screen. Built v0.41.0 (§7.4, §16.1).

Small items built: similar-name matching, frozen status, attrition at 30 / 180 / 365 days, new-hire survey axes, AI summary on the candidate page; and the 49 code fixes of the v0.33 review (security, privacy, data layer, Apps Script limits). The small items built v0.41.0 (§7.1, §9.1, §10.2, §16.1, §18); the code fixes in v0.34.0 – v0.37.0.

New look (v0.39): inbox home, stage board per vacancy, tabbed candidate file with the next step first, guided steps for long forms, global search; one colour per main section with sub-tabs in shades of it; Kandil red kept for the logo and primary buttons; red / green / orange reserved for statuses. Built v0.42.0 (§24.1).

Responsibilities in a JD by job level (JD standard v1.0, rule 4.2 — indicative): JL1–2 5–8, JL3 6–10, JL4–5 8–12, JL6–7 8–16 grouped under 4–6 areas; a hard cap of 16 and a floor of 3; above the level's band needs a written reason. Replaces «5 to 8». Built v0.42.1 (§3.3).

JD KPIs carry a type (weighted / monitoring) and a weight. Structural rules block: the weighted KPIs' weights add up to exactly 100, every weighted KPI has a weight. Numeric bands only warn (weighted KPIs JL1–3 3–5, JL4–5 4–6, JL6–7 5–7; at most 4 monitoring). Writing rules of the job-profile standard (closed verb list, job analysis, moved / deleted log, task-to-KPI mapping) stay in the authoring tool, not the portal. Built v0.42.2 (§3.3).

Factory pilot (operative family): a one-page worker card printed from the portal for any JD (offered first for JL1–2); required certificates and licences as a JD field; the work locations and the direct manager on the printed JD come from the structure (one JD, many positions), not from a field in the JD. Built v0.43.0 (§3.3).

Attendance enrolment on ZKBioTime (the company's attendance system on an internal server, ~20 machines, 150 mobile licences): the portal records only that a new hire's face and fingers were enrolled and the punch type (machines only / mobile + machines); no connection to ZKBioTime and no biometric data in the portal. HR records it and decides the type; mobile licences are counted against the licence number; on exit HR is told to stop the enrolment and the licence is freed when it is stopped. Existing employees can be recorded later from their file. Built v0.44.0 (§16.2).

The probation evaluator is a head of section (JL5) or higher — never a technician or a supervisor, even where the structure has a person report to a technician or a supervisor. The portal walks up from the employee's position to the first position at JL5 or above whose holder has a portal account; the skip-level reviewer the same way above him; none found → HR is told to set one. Built v0.44.1 (§17.2).

A job without a level of its own takes one from its grade, worked out when needed and never stored: grade 1–2 → JL1, 3–5 → JL2, 6–7 → JL3, 8 → JL4 when the title starts with «مشرف» or «رئيس», else JL3, 9–10 → JL5, 11–13 → JL6, 14–15 → JL7. A level set on the job (from its approved JD or on the jobs screen) always wins. The grade is not shown on what the employee receives — the printed JD and the JD sent by e-mail (JD standard decision D-21); it stays on HR screens. Built v0.44.2 (§3.3, §17.2).

Defect: the upgrade after the v0.44.0 deploy failed on every request (sign-in included) — the migration wrote the new onboarding-task column against the table's shared cached copy taken before the upgrade, which still had the old columns. The upgrade now reads every sheet whose columns it just changed from the sheet itself, never from that cache. Fixed v0.44.3 (§23).

When the upgrade after a deploy fails, the system owner gets one e-mail per version (the error reference and the first line of the technical error, at most 300 characters, no personal data) and users see «the portal has a problem with the update — the system administrator has been told» with the reference, instead of the generic error. Built v0.44.4 (§23).

Manager review of draft JDs: the HR Sector Manager or HR Manager opens a review round on the drafts (all, or one family) with a due date (default 10 working days); each job's reviewer is its direct manager from the structure; each manager gets one e-mail listing the jobs to review and an item in «المطلوب منك», reads each draft (no grade, D-21) and answers «agree» or «I have notes»; one reminder 2 working days before the due date; HR follows the round (who answered, the notes), exports the notes and closes it. Managers never edit a JD; approval stays with HR (and the CEO for a JD of the approver's own job). Built v0.45.0 (§3.3).

Back to the previous screen from anywhere: a «رجوع» button in the top bar returns to the screen (and its filter or tab) the user came from, and the browser's own Back button (and the phone's) does the same inside the portal. Nothing is stored beyond the current session; every screen opened this way is checked on the server as usual. Built v0.45.1 (§24).

«مين أونلاين»: the system owner and the HR Sector Manager (and the read-only consultant) see who has used the portal in the last 6 minutes and the name of the screen each is on — never the record inside it — live only, kept in the script cache for 10 minutes and never written to a sheet or a log. The usage policy says so; the policy version goes up so every user accepts it again. Built v0.45.1 (§24.3).

A calmer side menu (after Gusto and BambooHR): one section open at a time; reports and KPIs in a section of their own; the open screen shown in its section's colour with white text; a path «section › screen» above every screen title; the administration screens moved out of the menu behind a gear («الإدارة والإعدادات») that opens one settings page in four groups; the «who sees each screen» dots moved from the menu to that page. No permission changes. Built v0.46.0 (§24.4).

The signed no-insurance acknowledgement is a joining document (owner decision 10 Oct 2026): on the list of a contract without social insurance only, required, never deferred or waived, uploaded before the person is recorded as joined (the general «allow joining with missing documents» does not cover it); it shows on the documents receipt and is deleted with the other documents. It is printed from the offer card or the joining card; the signed copy is uploaded on the documents list only (an upload sent to the offer goes to the same document). Approval of a no-insurance offer is unchanged: the CEO, the Chairman or the Vice Chairman. Open joinings get the document on upgrade; a copy already uploaded on the offer moves onto it.

The fixed-term employment contract (owner decisions 10 Oct 2026, on the legal review's preliminary template, docs/legal on the review branch): a request of employment type «عقد محدد المدة» prints the two-page template — parties with the company's register, tax card, address and signatory; the worker's national ID, qualification, profession (the job title), insurance number (from the insurance case, else a line to fill), residence address; job, workplace and its address, work pattern; term in months with start and end dates (end = the day before the same date that many months later; converts to indefinite if continued without a written agreement); 90-day probation once; **the wage stated is the contribution wage (أجر الاشتراك)**, in figures and words, as the base for social insurance, allowances and incentives per the approved company rules (the full pay stays in the offer — art. 22 of decree 162/2026 left to the owner and the lawyer); pay by day PAY\_DAY of the next month; no resignation notice period; four copies; foot «نموذج مبدئي — يراجعه المحامي». Printing is refused, naming what is missing, until the company name, address, register, tax card and signatory, the worker's residence address and valid national ID, the start date, the wage and PAY\_DAY are all present. New data: the worker's residence address (on the person; set from «بيانات العقد» on the joining card by those with full access to the joining; in the person's data copy; deleted with the person and from the audit log), the contract's months (on the joining; CONTRACT\_MONTHS\_DEFAULT 12, 1–60), the company signatory and title (on the company, set by those who manage companies), PAY\_DAY (setting). The other employment types keep the short form until their templates are delivered, now also on the contribution wage (a contract without insurance, having no contribution wage, states its comprehensive wage). Server-written documents may now open in the portal's print theme (the same head, sections and foot as the other printed forms).

«مفردات الراتب عند بداية التعيين» (owner decisions 10 Oct 2026, on the legal review's draft docs/legal/05 and the company's current form): from the joining card, one A4 page in the portal's print theme, marked «نسخة الشركة فقط — سري» and «نموذج مبدئي — يراجعه المحامي»: the candidate, job, unit, sector, location and start date; every fixed pay line of the accepted offer by name and amount; the gross with the contract basis; the contribution wage, comprehensive wage, the employee's insurance and income tax (estimates) and the estimated net (marked when payroll has not reviewed it); the variable incentive; the no-insurance basis when there is one; the terms (PAY\_DETAILS\_TERMS, one per line, {probation\_days} and {pay\_day} filled in; empty = the legal session's default: dues within 7 days of the claim, resignation by the legal procedure with no notice period, joining documents followed up without withholding pay); signatures: prepared by (the printer, with the time), approved by the head of HR (HR\_HEAD\_NAME), and the candidate's acknowledgement that he has seen it. Printed only by the pay-view roles (owner, HR Sector Manager, HR Manager, Recruitment Manager and Supervisor) with full access to the joining; every print logged (PRINT\_PAY\_DETAILS); nothing stored or e-mailed, so nothing to delete; one signed paper copy kept in the service file (retention under art. 92 of law 14/2025 for the lawyer). It does not replace the pay statement art. 115 requires the employer to give the worker. The fixed-term contract now lists the allowances by name (the offer's pay lines, read correctly).

The payroll notice for missing joining documents is a notice to follow up, never a stop of pay (owner decision 10 Oct 2026, after the legal review: art. 36 of decree 162/2026 forbids withholding or deducting wages except as the law provides). Every label, hint and dialog says so («إخطار المرتبات — مسوغات ناقصة (للمتابعة، بدون إيقاف صرف)», «إخطار اكتمال المسوغات»); the stored kinds STOP / RELEASE are unchanged. Completing the documents is enforced lawfully instead: before joining (CHG-50), clause 13 of the contract (15 days), and the company's penalty table (for the lawyer).

Sign-in from a new device (owner decision 10 Oct 2026): the page keeps a random device id in its own storage and sends it with each sign-in (e-mail code or authenticator); the server keeps only its hash with the browser and system name and the first and last dates (USER\_DEVICES, security spreadsheet). A sign-in from a device the account has not used before — other than the first device known for the account, so existing users are not alerted on the first sign-in after the upgrade — is logged (NEW\_DEVICE) and the user is told in the portal and by e-mail (which device, when, and «if it was not you, tell the system administrator now»). Without a device id the browser string tells devices apart. Demo accounts and «try as» sessions are left out. One e-mail per new device, within the approval/internal e-mail budget.

Accounts nobody uses stop by themselves (owner decision 10 Oct 2026): the daily job stops an active account with no sign-in for DORMANT\_DAYS (60; counted from its creation when it never signed in; 0 = off) exactly as stopping it by hand does — sessions closed, its recruitment work back to «not assigned» — logs it (DORMANT\_STOPPED) and tells the system owner and the HR Sector Manager (portal, and one e-mail to the owner with the names). The system owner, the CEO and the board are never stopped this way; demo accounts are left out. Turning an account on again is a normal edit in «Users».

A tamper-evident audit log (owner decision 10 Oct 2026): every audit row is sealed when written, under the lock — Content\_Hash = two HMAC-SHA-256 seals (the row's fields; its old / new values) and Chain\_Hash = HMAC(previous Chain\_Hash, Content\_Hash) — with a key kept in Script Properties, never in a sheet, so someone who reaches the spreadsheet but not the script cannot forge a row. The newest seal is kept outside the sheet (a removed tail shows) and the last archived seal when old rows move to the archive (the chain goes on). Deleting a person's data blanks the values and marks the row Redacted: the fields' seal still guards the rest of the row and a redacted value can only read «محذوف». The daily job checks the whole live log; an edited value, an added, removed or moved row, or a removed tail is reported once a day to the system owner (portal and e-mail) and on the readiness screen («سلامة سجل التدقيق»). Rows written before v0.49.0 are not sealed.

The working hours and weekly rest agreed with the employee (owner decision 10 Oct 2026): two fields on the offer (review step) — daily working hours (1–12, whole or half hours) and the weekly rest (Friday, Saturday, Friday and Saturday, or a day a week by the shift roster) — starting from WORK\_HOURS\_DEFAULT (8) and WEEKLY\_REST\_DEFAULT (FRI). Seen and edited by those who see and edit the offer; not sensitive. Printed in the fixed-term contract (clause 10, paid weekly rest), the short contract, and the salary details (default terms; {work\_hours} and {weekly\_rest} in PAY\_DETAILS\_TERMS). An offer saved before has the settings' defaults.

The usage policy states that the portal records the devices an account signs in from (browser and system type, first and last sign-in) and alerts the user on a new device (CHG-104). The default policy text is updated and its version raised, so every user accepts it again; a policy the owner wrote himself is left as it is.

A branded sign-in (owner request 10 Oct 2026): the sign-in screen and the steps before the portal (authenticator set-up, usage policy, confidentiality acknowledgement) are split in two — a Kandil-red half with a glowing gold lantern (قنديل), «بوابة التوظيف» (in English «Recruitment Portal», all in English), one line on what the portal does and three of its stages, and the sign-in card on the other half. The brand half is on the start side, so it is on the right in Arabic and moves to the left in English; on a phone it becomes a short band above the card. Nothing in how signing in works changes.
